title: How to Dispute a Credit Card Transaction
summary: Explains when and how to dispute a Rho-Bank credit card transaction for unauthorized/fraudulent charges, duplicate charges, incorrect amounts, goods/services not received, item not as described, cancelled subscription still charging, or refunds not processed. Provides dispute start methods (1-800-RHO-BANK, Rho-Bank mobile app chat, rhobank.com/help) and what details to have ready (account info, purchase date, merchant name, amount).
